meta.note_on_sources: TASK.md names sources S1…S6, but SOURCES.md also contains S7 (rulings register row R-39). S7 is part of SOURCES.md, so it was coded.
meta.verdict_convention: FALSIFIED = at least one deciding pair. UNDETERMINED = no deciding pair, but at least one pair that could falsify the model once its UNK values were resolved. SURVIVES = neither. A pair counts as undetermined only if its known values do not already rule out falsification. For example, a known evidence(Q) < evidence(P) rules a pair out whatever the UNK values are.
meta.evidence_units_note: The frozen rule compares evidence integers. Units differ across sources (occurrences / slices / contexts). Integers were compared as written, and every cross-unit comparison is flagged.

M_C.statement: Under the frozen rule, M_C is needed only if every one of M_E, M_A, M_T and M_AT is falsified. M_E and M_T are falsified. M_A and M_AT have no deciding pair, so M_C is not formally required. M_C cannot be excluded either, because M_A and M_AT are UNDETERMINED rather than SURVIVES.
sensitivity: If E27 (R-39) were coded CHOICE, it would drop out as P. M_E would still be falsified via (E25,E24). M_T's only deciding pair would disappear, so M_T would become UNDETERMINED, unless E01's evidence is read as 1 or 2, which makes (E25,E01) deciding.
If cross-unit comparisons (occurrences / slices / contexts) were treated as not comparable: M_E would still be falsified via (E25,E24); M_T's pair (E02,E27) would become UNDETERMINED.

If the four S4-category-A promotions (E04, E05, E12, E13) were coded UNK instead of CHOICE: they would add ARB/OPERATING-INSTRUCTIONS P items with evidence 3 or ≥2. These create no deciding pairs against E20 (1) or E08 (1), only more undetermined pairs with E22 and E21. No verdict changes.
